description: Generate verifiable random values: up to 64 integers in a range, or a fair pick of n items from your own list, derived from a drand League of Entropy beacon round and returned together with the round number, the beacon randomness, its BLS signature and the exact derivation, so any third party can recompute and check the draw. Use it for lotteries, sampling, nonces, seat allocation and tie-breaks where the caller must be able to prove the result was not rigged. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Base, no account, no API key). 【価格】0.01 USDC。【使い方】呼ぶと 402 と PAYMENT-REQUIRED（支払い条件）が返る。USDC で支払い、同じ引数に PAYMENT-SIGNATURE ヘッダを添えて再送すると結果が返る。

choices.description: Optional: draw n distinct items from this list instead of integers (max 64)

max.description: Inclusive upper bound of the integer range (default 1000000)

min.description: Inclusive lower bound of the integer range (default 0)

n.description: How many values to draw (1-64, default 1)

round.description: Optional: pin a past drand round instead of the latest

salt.description: Optional string mixed into the derivation so two callers get different draws from the same beacon round

name: random
